rows.claim: Build tags after a '+' are ignored when sorting.
rows.evidence: The code in order.py strips '+' metadata via version.split('+',1)[0], but no tool output ever ran a version containing '+'. The sample sort at T0B8/T0B9 included no build tags, so the behavior was never shown.

rows.evidence: The code `base <= v and v[0] == base[0]` implies it, but no tool output tested a ^0.Y.Z range. Only ^1.2.3 cases were run, via the test suite.
